headerDisplay: Shows a HomeWizard P1 meter as eight Matter tiles. The W number on each tile is the value it stands for: W, Wh, kWh, litres or m3. Needs Matter turned on for the plugin's child bridge.

host.title: Meter IP address
host.description: IP address of the HomeWizard P1 meter. Turn on Local API for it in the HomeWizard Energy app.

electricityMonthSoFar.title: Electricity used this month so far (kWh)
electricityMonthSoFar.description: Optional, only for the month you install the plugin in: the HomeWizard app's month total. Without it, the month tiles start counting from the moment of install.

gasMonthSoFar.title: Gas used this month so far (m3)
